## Evidence and limits

Owner-submitted videos reviewed on 2026-11-15 showed the SHEIN app-search campaign and coupon receipt. The first recording clearly showed s4t32 in app search and WELCOME TO SHEIN. Neither recording established a coupon applied to a cart or a completed purchase. The owner reports Saudi Arabia as the test country; the country selection setting was not explicitly shown. Saudi riyal amounts were visible. Saudi Arabia is the site's current primary audience, not a guarantee that every Saudi account is eligible.

The owner reports the test date as 2026-11-15 and states that the supplied phone-clock screenshot belongs with the video. The screenshot visibly shows Sunday, 15 November and 4:51, plus a Hijri date of 4 Jumada II 1448 AH. A Gregorian year, AM/PM and time zone are not explicitly displayed. This is supporting owner-provided evidence, not an independently verified continuous timestamp for the coupon video. The screenshot does not prove a checkout discount or completed purchase. A lightweight public copy is available at https://tototete909090-collab.github.io/couponova/assets/evidence/clock-2026-11-15.webp.

Two readable coupons in that recording offered 50% on orders more than SAR 79, capped at SAR 40; and 40% on orders more than SAR 179, capped at SAR 80. Both stated new users only and selected products, with one day remaining at recording. These are observed, time-limited coupons, not guaranteed current offers or a fixed percentage discount from S4T32.

Worldwide availability and account eligibility are not independently verified. Use S4T32 in the app search bar; check the coupons currently available in your own account and the final order summary before payment. The website's official-store link is a homepage link, not automatic code activation or a campaign deep link.

H3RAW is not promoted by Couponova in this version. The original video and private account information are not published.

This file is informational only and does not guarantee indexing, rankings or inclusion in AI answers.
